lessons.culture: Because Gulf homes are air-conditioned (المكيف) most of the year, a blanket is often needed even in summer, and a guest is usually offered one without asking. The light is ضو, and أبشر ("good news") is the warm reply to any request, meaning "consider it done". A machine that has broken down is often called خربانة as well as ما تشتغل.

challenge.title: Meeting Family Over a Meal
challenge.instructions: Write and say a short Gulf Arabic conversation that lasts at least 10 lines. It must include a question about someone's family, a description of at least one relative, a statement of hunger or thirst, ordering or offering food and drink, the fixed exchange بالعافية / الله يعافيك or صحة وعافية / الله يعافيك, and asking for the bill. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 2 and include both a masculine-address form and a feminine-address form.
required_elements: A question about family using عندك عايلة كبيرة؟ or كم عددكم في العايلة؟
A description of at least one family member using أمي, أبوي, خوي, ختي, زوجي, مرتي, ولدي, or بنتي.
A statement of hunger or thirst using جوعان, جوعانة, or عطشان.
An order or offer of food or drink using أبي آكل or أبي أشرب.
The fixed exchange بالعافية / الله يعافيك, or صحة وعافية / الله يعافيك.
A request for the bill using الحساب لو سمحت or كم الحساب؟
Both a masculine-address form (such as عندك) and a feminine-address form (such as عندچ).
